title: SAW (Surface Acoustic Wave) - Band 2 (1900 MHz) for GPS/GNSS Anti-Jamming Filter
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Jennifer Kim

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a SAW (Surface Acoustic Wave) filter targeting Band 2 (1900 MHz) for GPS/GNSS Anti-Jamming Filter. The filter is designed on 128° YX LiNbO3 substrate with a target center frequency of 4056.8 MHz and bandwidth of 161.5 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the GPS/GNSS Anti-Jamming Filter module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: SAW (Surface Acoustic Wave)
- Frequency Band: Band 2 (1900 MHz)
- Application: GPS/GNSS Anti-Jamming Filter
- Substrate: 128° YX LiNbO3
- Package: SiP (System in Package)
- Design Tool: Cadence AWR Microwave Office
- Design Center: Irvine Design Center

This specification applies to all variants of the SAW (Surface Acoustic Wave) design targeting Band 2 (1900 MHz). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       4056.8 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       161.5 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 2.5 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 11.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 40.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 15.0 dB
Q Factor:               2974
Temperature Coefficient:-23.2 ppm/°C
Die Size:               1.3 x 1.2 mm
Wafer Size:             6-inch
Number of Resonators:   8
Electrode Material:     Pt/Al
Passivation:            SiO2
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Cadence AWR Microwave Office and load the SAW (Surface Acoustic Wave) template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: 128° YX LiNbO3 with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 4056.8 MHz, BW 161.5 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 2.5 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (SiP (System in Package)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (6-inch, 128° YX LiNbO3).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Anritsu MS46122B ShockLine.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 12170 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 2.5 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 11.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 242 MHz offset >= 40.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 7 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 11.8 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +31 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 2000 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 89%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2025-03-04
Devices Tested:         80
Insertion Loss (meas):  2.25 dB
Return Loss (meas):     13.1 dB
Rejection (meas):       42.6 dB
Isolation (meas):       20.3 dB
Q Factor (meas):        2974
Group Delay Variation:  1.3 ns
Power Handling:         +28 dBm
Die Yield:              82.8%

Result Classification:  CONDITIONAL PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The SAW (Surface Acoustic Wave) design demonstrated acceptable performance for Band 2 (1900 MHz).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Slight frequency drift observed at +85°C; TC layer thickness may need adjustment.
e) ESD robustness exceeded specification by 2x margin.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Review near-band rejection margin for worst-case temperature.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Schedule follow-up measurement after design tweak.
